title: LSV Sign Detection Feature Contract
description: Shared constants for backend validation, frontend inference, and model trainer. Keep in sync with landmark-validation.ts, signDetection.ts, and utils.py. featuresCount describes the captured/stored frame; staticFeaturesCount and dynamicFeaturesCount describe the model inputs derived from it.

modelPoseLandmarks.$comment: MediaPipe pose landmarks the models actually see. Excludes 17-22 (coarse hand points already covered by the 126-dim hand blocks) and 25-32 (knees, ankles, heels, feet: outside a waist-up framing, so MediaPipe extrapolates them).
